# Independent review: autocomplete launcher evidence successor V2

Supports bounded source/evidence successor patch `cc87bd3105d8e81837baee30c2c01eceab2bc512a9f5343c553a765b9e2a077f`, manifest `b9152517c224c07d0490c8b8fbd4e15f6445f690b1adcf878db9e3ff897bb1a6`, and review document `be121e9a9c4c3f95229ee3d244601fe56f0b9fc34060f07c49b37b4696c7b678`. This corrects the independently reproduced V1 direct-evidence binding regression; V1 and its failed context mutation remain retained.

All 42 V2 review keys, V5 path/hash/index pointers and prior conclusions match their actual immutable V5 records. Independently compared each row's direct evidence set with its V5 predecessor: all 39 unaffected V5 references remain directly bound, while the stale old launcher is replaced with its archived historical bytes. The two additional live bindings are the current launcher and the sandbox repair record. The unchanged helper does not recurse through the V5 pointer; direct evidence carry-forward is therefore material. V5's nested prior history and the archived V4 source packet preserve the earlier source-review and version-loss context.

The proposed data-only old launcher archive byte-matches Git commit 182e and SHA `ad5af681f9cd02c3596d05e524b3ee54faf4e92dc969285b62da279a57fc1c57`; the live launcher and repair record match their manifest hashes. The actual Git diff from 182e to 8e9 removes only `--no-sandbox`. No browser run or sandboxed autocomplete requalification is claimed, and old launcher-dependent observations remain historical.

The patch applies strictly in a private index at 8e9 and yields candidate ledger SHA `790d91b9061a2545c44972c72e7d211b4e2451766a55eb3155e3399f85e5c9b2`. Independent JSON-AST comparison confirms exactly the selected 42 rows changed and the remaining 1,694 row spans remain byte-identical and ordered. Full predecessor rows reconstruct from their appended history. All 42 target preimages still match the live ledger at observed HEAD 9e2342e3dba0ebb063d8bab35cc4ca7130db1118; integration must recheck the moving tree.

An independent invocation of unchanged `authoredUseReviewEvidence` and `authoredUseInventory` reproduced 1,323 reviewed / 413 insufficient before and 1,365 / 371 after, exactly the 42 selected keys improved with no newly insufficient keys. Mutations of the current trigger, line, repair record, archived launcher and current launcher each reopen all 42. Independent mutations to the previously omitted render helper, owned errors, form field and owned tokens also each reopen all 42. Prior pointer/index mutation is caught by the separate preflight; the production helper does not inspect predecessor pointers recursively.

All manifest artifacts were independently rehashed. This is source/evidence binding review, not an actual new browser execution, whole-ledger admission, runtime floor, G11 or release qualification.
